name: AutoRemesher
description: A dense sculpt in, clean all-quad topology out: AutoRemesher's field-aligned remesher rebuilds the surface as an even quad mesh at the polygon budget you pick, returned as a GLB.
overview: AutoRemesher (MIT, by the Dust3D author) turns a high-polygon triangle mesh into quad topology. It decimates the input, builds a smooth cross field over the surface, extracts the singularity and feature structure from it, parameterizes each patch and cuts the surface into quads whose size follows the target count — so the result is a single connected quad mesh at a predictable density instead of a voxel retopo or a triangle soup. Sharp edges above the dihedral threshold are preserved as feature loops, and Adaptivity / Anisotropy let the quads grow where the surface is flat and shrink along curvature and ridges. Drop a GLB on the canvas, select that 3D layer, set the quad budget and Run. The result is a GLB for the canvas viewer; the untriangulated quad OBJ is returned alongside it, because glTF can only carry triangles and a DCC tool wants the real quads. No textures or UVs are transferred — this cartridge produces topology, so it is the step before you re-texture or project UVs.

parameters.name: input_mesh
parameters.label: Input Mesh
parameters.description: The selected 3D layer is uploaded here automatically.

parameters.name: target_quads
parameters.label: Target Quads
parameters.description: Quad budget for the whole surface. The remesher hits it within a few percent.

parameters.name: edge_scaling
parameters.label: Edge Scaling
parameters.description: How much denser the quads get along feature edges. 1 keeps the target density uniform.

parameters.name: sharp_edge
parameters.label: Sharp Edges
parameters.description: Dihedral angle threshold in degrees. Edges sharper than this are preserved as feature loops.

parameters.name: adaptivity
parameters.label: Adaptivity
parameters.description: Curvature-adaptive quad density. 0 is uniform, 1 puts the finer quads in high-curvature areas.

parameters.name: anisotropy
parameters.label: Anisotropy
parameters.description: Curvature-adaptive elongation. 0 keeps square quads, 1 stretches them along the flatter direction on tubes and ridges.

parameters.name: smooth_normal
parameters.label: Smooth Normal
parameters.description: Smooth normal angle threshold in degrees. 0 remeshes the faceted surface as-is; larger values respect the original vertex normals.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.label: Timeout
parameters.description: Seconds the remesher may run before the job is failed.
